newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hai Hong denies acquisition rumours.
newsitem.headline: Hai Hong denies acquisition rumours.

text.p: China Merchants Hai Hong Holdings Co Ltd said it was not aware of any discloseable matter in relation to rumours of a possible acquisition.

"It is not aware of any matter discloseable" under listing rules which is or may be of a price sensitive nature, Hai Hong said in a statement on Friday. "There are no negotiations or agreements relating to intended acquistions or realisation" which are discloseable under listing rules, it added.
The company said there had been market speculation that it may acquire a stake in Chun Wo Holdings Ltd, a civil engineering concern, by way of a general offer.
Hai Hong shares fell HK$0.25 to HK$15.95 Friday morning.

Chun Wo said in a separate statement that its shares were suspended on Thursday at the request of Hong Kong stock exchange because of recent unusual increases in the trading volume and prices of its shares.
Chun Wo said it was not aware of any reason behind the increase and that no negotiations were underway.

"The Securities and Futures Commission and the Stock Exchange are conducting their enquiry," Chun Wo said. "Trading in the shares will remain suspended until they are satisfied that fair and orderly trading of the shares can take place."
